UNIVERSITY OF ST ANDREWS

School of Mathematical & Computational Sciences

Research Assistant/Fellow

Two 1-year posts for applied statisticians exist in the Research Unit for
Wildlife Population Assessment (RUWPA). With the right applicants, job-share
arrangements for either post would be possible. The appointees will be
involved in one or more of the following projects: development of generalised
additive model (GAM) methods for estimating fish biomass; development of
methods for assessing fish discard rates; spatial modelling of wildlife
populations from line transect surveys; development of methods for improving
survey based estimation of fish abundance using GAMs and/or state-space models
and/or Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods.

You should have a good honours degree in statistics, or in biology, maths or
applied maths with a strong statistical background. Experience with one or
more of the following would be an advantage: line transect sampling or
fisheries assessment methodology; S-Plus; generalised linear models; GAMs;
MCMC methods.

Salary will be at the appropriate point on the 1A or 1B scale for research
staff, i.e.د15,735- د23,651 per annum. Informal enquiries may be made to Dr.
David Borchers (tel. +44 (0) 1334 463806, e-mail d...@mcs.st-and.ac.uk) or
Prof. Stephen Buckland (tel. +44 (0) 1334 463787, e-mail
st...@mcs.st-and.ac.uk). More information on RUWPA can be found at
http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/.

Please quote ref: KC117/AMC1/99 Closing Date: 29 April /99

Application forms and further particulars from Personnel Services, University
of St Andrews, College Gate, North Street, St Andrews, Fife KY16 9AJ, (tel:
01334 462571, by fax 01334 462570 or by e-mail Job...@st-andrews.ac.uk). We
regret applications cannot be made by e-mail.
